digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The day closed with six carried priorities still active and a tightly sequenced EPMO schedule ahead tomorrow. Amazon Connect has encouraging initial test results, but the final regression and Denver release decision still need to close.

items.label: Lock the Amazon Connect Denver decision
items.detail: Initial testing indicates voicemail and Conversation Analytics are working, and a full-regression checklist was shared for review. Complete the regression evidence, reconcile any remaining analytics questions, and confirm the queue sequence, release gates, rollback steps, ownership gaps, and final Denver go/no-go decision.

items.label: Remediate the critical Supabase RLS warning
items.detail: Verify the affected public table, enable the intended protections, and confirm the Security Advisor alert clears.

items.label: Turn the MHE requirement into an owned rollout
items.detail: Assign owners and dates for intake scripts, cost disclosure, prior-client re-offers, provider-state coverage, task-set changes, and rollout. Keep the legal guidance and operational readiness explicit before mental health evaluations become a standard sign-up requirement.

items.label: Reset the Quality intake path with Sara
items.detail: Use Friday's follow-up with Sara and Licelot to evaluate Quality gaps within the larger project context before submitting a new intake, and incorporate the refreshed CM CoE governance guidance.

items.label: Complete the LeadUp growth-mindset follow-up survey
items.detail: The Module 3 follow-up survey remains open. Use a short low-context window tomorrow or set a firm completion time.

items.label: Confirm the Cross-Firm Lead Intake project name
items.detail: Confirm whether Mar's new project is the item labeled Cross-Firm Lead Intake so the leadership deck and project records remain consistent.

items.label: BCP and Incident Response touchpoint was cancelled
items.detail: Jean sent the cancellation notice for today's weekly meeting after receiving decline notices.

items.label: Fold the Team Lead Suspensions request into the new Matter plan
items.detail: Licelot confirmed that the on-hold CoE request is now part of the Phase 1 Matter plan and that the standalone request can be cancelled.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect daily standup
items.detail: Bring the completed regression evidence and final Denver decision record forward if the release gate is still open.

items.label: 11:30 AM to 2:00 PM - Armando 1:1, protected work time, and EPMO management
items.detail: Use the noon work block to prepare the few owners, capacity questions, dates, and risks leadership needs.

items.label: 2:30 PM to 3:30 PM - Pipeline sync and executive status update
items.detail: Carry the latest intake, UAT, Amazon Connect, MHE, and governance decisions into the project pipeline and executive deck.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Knowledge Management project touchpoint
items.detail: Review the project's current position and agree on next steps with Nicolas.

items.label: Mar is out Friday and Monday
items.detail: Route urgent portfolio and governance follow-ups to available owners before the weekend.
